about_the_game:
About This Game

Tiny Fisherman is a relaxing yet engaging fishing simulation game set in the heart of the ocean. Discover hundreds of unique recipes, improve your fishing skills, and expand your humble little shop to become the most legendary fisherman in the world!

Is this life really for you? There’s only one way to find out—grab your rod, hop on your boat, and set sail to explore the mysteries of the sea! Whether you prefer fishing near peaceful island shores or chasing big fish in the middle of the ocean, the choice is entirely yours.

Every fish you catch brings you closer to discovering new recipes. As your shop grows, you’ll attract more customers, unlock better equipment, and build the seafood restaurant of your dreams. Fishing here isn’t just about patience—it’s about exploration, strategy, and entrepreneurial spirit. Tiny Fisherman delivers the ultimate “fishing fantasy” experience.

🔍 Key Features:

  • Genre: Fishing / Simulation / Cozy Management

  • Core Gameplay: Cast your line, catch rare fish, unlock delicious recipes, and grow your own fish shop

  • Atmosphere: Calm, colorful, and charming world—fish freely along peaceful shores or in the open sea

  • Progression: Unlock new islands, upgrade your gear, expand your customer base, and complete your recipe collection

  • Game Design: Simple yet addictive mechanics perfect for short, relaxing play sessions

  • Technical: Built with the Unity engine – optimized for low-end systems and smooth performance

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3000 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 550
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel Core i5 6600k
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050TI

short_description: Tiny Fisherman is a fishing simulator game where you try to expand your fish restaurant, cooking and frying food. You have a vast kitchen with dozens of different recipes. How about becoming the best fisherman in the universe?
